dog.description_text:
Meet Tomato! Loving and cuddly, this adorable 11-month-old, 7 lb male Chihuahua is a proud little tripod who never lets his three legs slow him down. He loves playing with his toys, settling down easily for cozy naps, and soaking up belly scratches that sometimes even bring out a big smile. He gets along wonderfully with his bigger foster dog sibling and is an easy, affectionate companion around the house.

In his foster placement, Tomato hangs out happily in his crate without any issues. He is currently working on building his confidence around busy city sidewalks, where he loves sniffing the air and exploring the fall leaves.

Registered adopters interested in Tomato can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
